_comment: Retention rules (Week 9, Deliverable 4). Keyed on the dataset ids in data_inventory.json. retention_sweep.py reads this file; a rule with no sweeper entry is a poster, not a control - the sweeper stub enforces these.

triage_messages.basis: TEACHING LABEL - minimum necessary period for clinical follow-up; legal review pending

audit_logs.basis: TEACHING LABEL - accountability and incident investigation window

deletion_records.basis: TEACHING LABEL - the record of a deletion must outlive the sweep that performed it

sweeper.mode: stub - demonstrates the sweep against a fixture store; the production job would be a cron entry calling the same function
